propositions: Eight Jira modules at package root must be physically moved into adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035 architectural constraint.
The three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require lazy_load() to resolve via relative subpath to new location without breaking other root-module loads.
All surviving dotted imports and sibling-path references across adapters/jira/jira_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, acli.py, and acli_cli_ops.py must be atomically repointed to new adapter paths.
Test imports and path constants (categories 2 and 3) referencing moved modules must be rewritten to adapters/jira/ paths; path-agnostic patch.object() mocks remain unchanged.
The migration is atomic with no re-export shims; grep for old root paths of moved modules must yield zero hits post-migration and full test suite must pass.
